item: Markets lists commodity and topic coverage co-movements (Lane M routes)
summary: GET /api/signals/supply-chain-ripple had no button; Home showed at most a couple of these pairs as Leads. Markets now lists every pair surviving the FDR correction with r, q, distinct sources and an Articles button on the exact ids, plus pairs tested and window. Scan runs on the reader's click, never per visit. Short co-occurrence caveat visible in every state (R685), long caveat and method in hovers; the server's empty notes map to keyed sentences. FEATURE_CEILING 43 to 42.
